title: Choo-choo train, the one line again, five days on
model: Purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (the same Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8 as v5), local and free, with the harness as of commit e2d7a02 (context discipline: scratch notes, more segments, a trimmed prompt); the same message as v5, word for word
verdict: Almost flawless, in the Captain's judgement: the most detailed locomotive yet (an iron boiler with bands, stack, dome, cab windows, cowcatcher, a tall curling smoke plume) on a track with a station and trees. Corrected 2026-10-31: this page used to say its wheels faced along the track, but there are no wheels to see in any view, and the wheel check finds none under the engine. The real mistakes: no wheels at all, and the tender and the passenger car stand out sideways beside the track instead of behind the engine. Smaller: the plume and a few trim blocks float (8 parts, against v5's zero), and it is a fifth of v5's blocks in three times the time, with the same model and the same words.
